_comment: Optional config. Delete this file and the scanner still works with safe defaults. All keys are optional.
_base_ref: Git ref to diff against for scoped scans. null = auto-detect (origin/main, main, ...).
_disabled_checks: List any check ids you never want to run, e.g. ["gitleaks", "npm-audit"]. Valid ids: ruff, ruff-format, mypy, bandit, pip-audit, eslint, prettier, tsc, npm-audit, gitleaks, supabase.
